Control options for `est="nuts"` (Stan's NUTS sampler)

Source: R/stanSugar.R
nutsControl.Rd

`nutsControl()` is [stanControl()] with `algorithm = "NUTS"` forced – the same options, named after the SAMPLING ALGORITHM instead of the software tool, the way nlmixr2est's `foceControl()` is `foceiControl()` with `interaction = FALSE` forced. Because `class(nutsControl())` is `"nutsControl"`, `nlmixr2(model, data, nutsControl())` infers `est="nuts"` with no `est=` argument.

Usage

nutsControl(..., algorithm = "NUTS")

Arguments

...

[stanControl()] options

algorithm

must be `"NUTS"` (present so a [stanControl()] can be converted to a `nutsControl`; a variational algorithm errors)

Value

a `nutsControl` list

Details

`"NUTS"` is already [stanControl()]'s default, so this is mostly a naming convenience; asking for a variational algorithm here is an error rather than a silent override.

See also

[stanControl()], [adviControl()], [pathfinderControl()]

Author

Matthew L Fidler

Examples

# nutsControl() is stanControl() with algorithm pinned to NUTS, so
# nlmixr2(model, data, nutsControl()) needs no est= argument
ct <- nutsControl(iter = 500L)
ct$algorithm
#> [1] "NUTS"
ct$iter
#> [1] 500
